# Mod <Badge type="info" text="class" />

<p class="api-meta">Namespace <code>Lustral</code> · Assembly <code>Lustral.Api</code></p>

The base class of a mod's entry point. Lustral creates one instance of each mod and calls it on the game's main thread.

```csharp
public abstract class Mod
```

## Remarks

[`Info`](/api/mod#info), [`Log`](/api/mod#log), [`Harmony`](/api/mod#harmony), [`Config`](/api/mod#config), [`Events`](/api/mod#events), [`Coroutines`](/api/mod#coroutines), [`Assets`](/api/mod#assets), [`Game`](/api/mod#game) and [`Mods`](/api/mod#mods) are available from the constructor onward. Code outside the class, such as Harmony patches, can access them through a static reference to the instance, as in the project template.

## Properties

### Assets {#assets}

```csharp
public ModAssets Assets { get; }
```

Loads Unity asset bundles shipped with the mod, on both Mono and IL2CPP: `Assets.LoadBundle("Assets/ui.bundle")`. Paths are relative to the mod's folder. Bundles can be loaded from [`OnGameReady`](/api/mod#ongameready) onward.

### Config {#config}

```csharp
public ModConfig Config { get; }
```

The mod's settings file, `Lustral/config/<id>.toml`: `Config.Bind<Settings>()`.

### Coroutines {#coroutines}

```csharp
public Coroutines Coroutines { get; }
```

The mod's coroutines, which behave identically on Mono and IL2CPP: `Coroutines.Start(Fade())`. A coroutine is an iterator method that yields `null`, [`Wait`](/api/wait) values, other iterators or Unity yield instructions.

### Events {#events}

```csharp
public GameEvents Events { get; }
```

Scene and frame events.

### Game {#game}

```csharp
public GameInfo Game { get; }
```

The game's name, developer, version, Unity version, scripting backend and folder.

### Harmony {#harmony}

```csharp
public Harmony Harmony { get; }
```

A Harmony instance identified by the mod's ID: `Harmony.PatchAll(typeof(MyMod).Assembly)`. If the mod fails to load, Lustral removes the patches applied through this instance. Crash reports use it to identify the mod that patched each method.

### Info {#info}

```csharp
public ModInfo Info { get; }
```

The mod's ID, name, version and folder, as declared in its manifest.

### Log {#log}

```csharp
public ILog Log { get; }
```

The mod's log. Messages are tagged with the mod's ID and may contain Unity rich text tags (see [`ILog`](/api/i-log)).

### Mods {#mods}

```csharp
public LoadedMods Mods { get; }
```

The mods loaded so far, in load order: `Mods.IsLoaded("other.mod")`. Dependencies and optional dependencies are loaded before the mods that depend on them, so an installed optional dependency is always in this list.

## Methods

### OnGameReady() {#ongameready}

```csharp
public virtual void OnGameReady();
```

Called once, after the game's first scene has loaded. Unity APIs can be used from this point on.

### OnLoad() {#onload}

```csharp
public virtual void OnLoad();
```

Called once, before the game loads its first scene. Apply Harmony patches here. Unity APIs cannot be used yet.

### OnShutdown() {#onshutdown}

```csharp
public virtual void OnShutdown();
```

Called once when the game quits. Limit the work to short tasks such as saving state and closing files.
